results.title: The Fix
results.overview: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war-torn ex-CIA operatives set out to Tehran to take down a life-changing score.

results.title: The Fix
results.overview: When a troubled model takes a new drug at a party, she suffers a shocking transformation. Pursued by authorities and a dangerous gang, she hunts for a fix to reverse these effects, only to discover her mutations could save the human race.

results.title: The Fixation
results.overview: Álvaro, an accomplished photographer struggling with debt and his father’s terminal illness, reluctantly accepts an erotic photography assignment designed to recruit VIP clients. But the project takes an unexpected turn when he discovers that its star is Felipe, a famous model with whom he shares a turbulent past. Their reunion reignites a toxic relationship fueled by desire, jealousy, and obsession. As tensions escalate and increasingly dangerous situations surround the project, Álvaro must navigate the blurred lines between passion and madness while fighting to maintain his sanity—and survive.

results.title: Fixing the Rare: Breeder A
results.overview: Fixing the Rare: Breeder A is a fiction hybrid film following the struggle of an imaginary goldfish breeder in pursuit of the ultimate goldfish. Inspired by interviews with real breeders and excerpts from their diaries, it traces a story of obsession caught between preservation and transformation. Through his experimental journey, the audience indirectly witnesses the process by which life is born, selected, polished, and culled.

results.title: Mechanic: Resurrection
results.overview: Arthur Bishop thought he had put his murderous past behind him when his most formidable foe kidnaps the love of his life. Now he is forced to travel the globe to complete three impossible assassinations, and do what he does best, make them look like accidents.
